text: This is AlloraVoice – live translation for KDE Plasma.
Watching a course or a video in a language you don't fully understand? Following every word is exhausting.
AlloraVoice simply listens along and speaks everything in your language – with a natural voice.
It captures your system audio, Whisper recognizes the speech, the text is translated, and a Microsoft neural voice reads it aloud – while the original is turned down.
Click the headset icon to open the popup. Switch translation on, pick a language pair, and watch what is being said – live.
Choose from all Microsoft neural voices in seventy-three languages – female or male.
Seek in the video and AlloraVoice follows. If someone speaks fast, the voice speeds up smoothly instead of cutting sentences off.
To install, download the file, add it through Add Widgets, drag it into your panel, and click set up.
AlloraVoice is open source under the GPL version three. Enjoy learning!
